confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or booking sites. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain, and July may run firmer around Peru's 28-29 July national holidays. wine_glass is set at roughly 1.7x the beer anchor because direct knowledge of by-the-glass wine prices is weaker. Local examples assume about 3.5 soles per USD. FX is the latest RBA figure located (13 Oct 2026, reported in search results from the RBA Exchange Rates Overview); no 14 Oct figure was found and the RBA table itself was not directly verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors reflect general knowledge of Peru's price levels for tourist-facing restaurants, bars, hostels and hotels in Lima's Miraflores, Barranco and central districts.
